_meta.verdict: NEITHER RULE EARNS CORE FROM THIS PASS. The 10% core ceiling is cleared at n=35 with zero false positives (Wilson: z^2/(n+z^2) = 9.89%); 34 gives 10.15% and 32 gives 10.72%. 6.0 stays open, and the shortfall is arithmetic, not judgement — see the four RETRACT rows below, which are why the count is 19 usable rows rather than 23.
